attributes.name: Beverach
attributes.powers:
Beverach is immune to the Cold trait. If your check to defeat has the Fire trait, add 1d8.

Before you act, each character at your location must succeed at a Dexterity or Acrobatics 10 check or be dealt 1d4-1 Cold damage and cannot move this turn.
